item.title: MirrorCam 1.4.6
item.description: - Soft light now shows the whole picture, as with the light off, only a little smaller. Before, it was cropped to a wide strip - A new icon, matching ConvertExt's: Apple's own blue, with plain white artwork - Windows now have the Mac's current look on macOS 26 and later (the taller title bar and bigger window buttons, as Finder) - Remember my settings: turning it on now keeps exactly what you have at that moment. Before, anything you hadn't changed since opening MirrorCam could come back from an earlier time - Settings has the Mac's standard spacing and one close button, like every other window - The menus have the Mac's standard items: Services, Zoom and Bring All to Front - Behind-the-scenes tidy-up
